info.name: Returns users linked to the account slug provided.

params.name: slug
params.description: Filter by Account slug.

params.name: email
params.description: Filter by List of emails.

params.name: first-name
params.description: Filter by List of First Names.

params.name: last-name
params.description: Filter by List of Last Names.

params.name: user-slug
params.description: Filter by List of User slugs.

params.name: has-accepted-invitation
params.description: Boolean flag. Use true to return users whose invitation has already been accepted, and false to return users whose invitation has not been accepted.

params.name: user-type
params.description: Filter by List of user types.

params.name: reverse
params.description: Reverse the order of the list to be provided.

params.name: sort-key
params.description: Sorts the given list by a key. Allowed values: slug, email, first_name, last_name, account_slug, last_active_at, user_type.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to be accessed according to the division of items provided in conjunction with the 'per-page' parameter.

params.name: per-page
params.description: Number of users per page on the provided list.

items.docs: Returns users linked to the account slug provided.
